title: Well--posedness and homogenization of a waste--protein clearance model in cortical tissue
summary: We formulate and analyze a mathematical model for the clearance of waste proteins from cortical tissue. The model tracks three species of waste proteins, distinguished by their size, and incorporates constant production at neuronal surfaces, reaction-diffusion in the bulk of interstitial fluid, and nonlinear dynamics on capillary surfaces. We establish the existence, boundedness, and uniqueness of a solution to the microscopic model.
